original.statement: Three Helm configuration keys for the metallb-bgp integration (bgp.enabled, bgp.announce.podCIDR, and bgp.announce.loadbalancerIP) have been removed; users must migrate to bgpControlPlane options for BGP announcements.

decision.reason: The upgrade notes say the metallb-bgp Helm options `bgp.enabled`, `bgp.announce.podCIDR` and `bgp.announce.loadbalancerIP` were removed, and users must now use the options under `bgpControlPlane` [ev-42d13e5eb7d7]. Validators comparing the two values files found that `bgp` exists in the 1.15.6 values and is gone from the 1.17.0 values, which confirms the subject helm-value `bgp` and the change type removed [ev-28e0ccb5774a] [ev-39a22d88e2f5]. The notes name `bgpControlPlane` as the options to use instead, so replacedBy is supported.
